Pistons @ Spurs 7/10 7:00 - Wemby's Spurs vs a banged-up Pistons
Knicks @ Raptors 7/10 6:30 - Champs on road, Barnes questionable
Blazers @ Wolves 6/10 7:00 - Edwards out, both on back-to-backs

games.notes: Duren, Robinson, Prince and Joe out for Detroit. Wemby and the 12-2 Spurs should win at home, though Cade's Pistons are a fun young team to watch.
Barnes questionable with illness for Toronto. Defending champ Knicks on the road against a young Raptors team; should be competitive, and Barnes' status decides how much.
Edwards, Kuminga and DiVincenzo out for Minnesota; Avdija questionable, Sharpe and Morant out for Portland. Both teams on a back-to-back after playing last night, so expect a sloppy, close one.
Knueppel and Schroder out for Charlotte; Reaves and Kessler out for LA. Lakers still far better, likely comfortable win.
Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr. out for Utah; Beal and Brandon Ingram out for the Clippers. Two lottery-bound teams, skip it.
